headings.text: The sensitivity you require with the robustness you need

The Citrine system is our high-performance benchtop in vitro diagnostic medical device mass spectrometer that provides ultimate sensitivity and robustness to meet the demands of your most challenging clinical diagnostics assays. The Citrine system is a flexible platform that provides the ultimate performance and reliability to tackle today’s most challenging assays while providing the versatility to address tomorrow’s clinical diagnostics and research needs.
Explore the advantages of the Citrine system series for your laboratory
The destination for all your support needs.

Status: Available Require more information? Learn more

The Citrine system combines ultimate sensitivity and robustness to routinely analyze challenging compounds. Delivering the legendary robustness and reliability of a SCIEX mass spectrometry solution, the Citrine MS/MS system is specifically designed to meet the demands of clinical laboratories that require maximum sensitivity and reliability for challenging clinical assays. Experience the advantages of the Citrine system so you can measure low-levels biomarkers and elevate your clinical laboratory's capabilities.
Long term, stable performance, analyzing all common matrices for routine clinical assays without the need for operator intervention
Achieve the required detection limits for your routine high throughput assays, such as prescribed drugs and Vitamin D, in both positive and negative ionization modes
Benefit from enhanced selectivity with unique scanning functions to improve specificity and limits of detection for challenging compounds in complex biological matrices
Generate both quantitative and qualitative data with our unique hybrid QTRAP technology, maximizing information and improving confidence from a single injection

Multiple ionization options, extended mass and linear dynamic ranges and both fast scanning and polarity switching make the Citrine system the perfect platform for the analysis of a wide variety of biomarkers, lipids, proteins, peptides and non-endogenous compounds in complex biological matrices
Transform LC-MS/MS data into meaningful and actionable results to improve patient care with our suite of software solutions tailored to your clinical diagnostics applications.

Streamline your workflows and accelerate delivery with software designed for all the latest SCIEX mass spectrometry systems, with Windows 11 support to meet IT security policies and reduce cybersecurity risks.
Powerful LC-MS/MS control, streamlined data management and compliance for your SCIEX devices.
Seamlessly process and accurately quantify multiple analytes across numerous samples with flexible software.
Streamline your LC-MS/MS clinical diagnostic testing with a simple 4-step workflow and intuitive point-and-click interface.
Effortlessly process batch sample screening results with user-friendly and personalized reports.
